name: JavaDoc Snippet Validation

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh'
      - 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh'
      - '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh'
      - 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh'
      - '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml'

jobs:
  validate-snippets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Determine changed files
        id: changed-files
        run: |
          echo "changed_files=$(git diff --name-only ${{ github.sha }}^ ${{ github.sha }})" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Check if only script files changed
        id: only_scripts
        run: |
          changed="${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.changed_files }}"
          is_script_only=true
          for file in $changed; do
            if [[ ! "$file" =~ ^scripts/.*\.sh$ ]] && [[ ! "$file" =~ ^\.github/workflows/.*\.yml$ ]]; then
              is_script_only=false
              break
            fi
          done
          echo "is_script_only=$is_script_only" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Skip if non‑script files changed
        if: ${{ steps.only_scripts.outputs.is_script_only != 'true' }}
        run: |
          echo "Non‑script files changed, skipping snippet validation."
          exit 0

      - name: Extract JavaDoc snippets
        id: extract
        run: |
          mkdir -p snippets
          scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh > snippets/snippets.jsonl

      - name: Validate snippets
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          any_fail=0
          while IFS= read -r line; do
            sourceFile=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.sourceFile')
            symbol=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.symbol')
            snippetIndex=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.snippetIndex')
            startLine=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.startLine')
            endLine=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.endLine')
            code=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.code')
            echo "Validating snippet $symbol:$snippetIndex ($startLine-$endLine) in $sourceFile"
            if ! printf '%s' "$code" | scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh; then
              echo "Snippet $symbol:$snippetIndex failed"
              any_fail=1
            fi
          done < snippets/snippets.jsonl
          if [ "$any_fail" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "One or more snippets failed validation."
            exit 1
          fi
